buildRating.scope: Equipment and purchased build power, not player skill. Normalize each role against its own baseline.

brutal.endlessTrigger: A completed Standard identity returns Brutal; after a completed Brutal appearance it returns Crazed.

endless.rewards: Completed-encounter mastery, cosmetics and local streak records. Power purchases stop at their normal caps.

personalShieldCapacity.calculation: Floor maximum health times difficulty capacity fraction times one plus the bounded class bonus. Hellish always zero. Capacity purchases do not refill shields.

difficulties.name: Insane
difficulties.unlock: Complete any full campaign route on Hard.

difficulties.name: Hellish
difficulties.unlock: Complete any full campaign route on Hard.

modes.name: Quarantine Run
modes.description: A five-contract passage from the breached gate to the drowned seat of government.

modes.name: Midnight Circuit
modes.description: The full city circuit, balancing build development with a compact evening session.

modes.name: Black Bell Pilgrimage
modes.description: A longer rescue pilgrimage through all districts, with champions and additional survivor testimony.

modes.name: Grand Raid
modes.description: Three extended encounters with an accelerated starting build and larger cooperative objectives.

modes.name: Endless Vigil
modes.description: No final round. Survive successive bosses indefinitely, vote on mutations, shop between encounters, and pursue a personal and squad streak. Solo, private and public play.

modes.name: Story: The Open Ledger
modes.description: A fifteen-fight story campaign in three acts. Party votes choose regions and contracts, and shape one of three recorded endings. Party Ready leads directly to route decisions; mutations are reserved for Free Play. Uses the current prototype build budget.

classes.name: Soldier
classes.role: Reliable ranged damage and squad leadership.
classes.lore: A former night-watch officer who refused the order to bar the infirmary doors. Mara counts everyone before she moves.

abilities.name: Rally Field
abilities.description: Allies in the field gain 20% weapon damage and 10% movement speed.

abilities.name: Precision Burst
abilities.description: Fire three accurate piercing rounds toward the aim point.

ultimate.name: Last Roll Call
ultimate.description: Reload allies instantly, clear nearby hostile projectiles once and grant 35% weapon damage in the rally field for 8 seconds.

classes.name: Heavy
classes.lore: Hux once kept the foundry running through winter. He now carries its last functioning feed motor into the streets.

abilities.name: Suppressing Cone
abilities.description: Fire fourteen rounds in a cone and slow ordinary enemies by 40%.

abilities.name: Braced Firing
abilities.description: Gain 45% damage resistance and 30% fire rate; move at 60% speed.

ultimate.name: Foundry Overture
ultimate.description: Overdrive the weapon for 6 seconds with 70% additional fire rate, two extra pierces and no magazine consumption; movement is reduced.

classes.name: Tank
classes.lore: A gate engineer carrying a door that outlived its building. Bram insists a shield is only useful with someone behind it.

abilities.name: Protective Wall
abilities.description: Place a 150-health bullet-blocking wall that allies can walk through.

abilities.name: Rescue Charge
abilities.description: Charge toward the aim point, gain brief invulnerability and damage nearby enemies.

ultimate.name: The City Holds
ultimate.description: Grant nearby allies 120 shield and 35 percentage points of armor for 8 seconds. Armor respects the global cap; identical fields do not stack.

classes.name: Medic
classes.lore: Iona wrote names on bandages when the city ran out of paper. She refuses to let the bells make those names meaningless.

abilities.name: Healing Field
abilities.description: Restore 8 health per second to allies inside the field.

abilities.name: Cleansing Serum
abilities.description: Heal nearby allies for 20 health and remove poison and slow effects.

ultimate.name: Names Returned
ultimate.description: After a one-second channel, revive nearby downed or eliminated allies according to the selected difficulty. Heal living allies for 40, cleanse effects and deal 35 damage nearby. Solo also gains 40 shield.

classes.name: Mage
classes.role: Area control and magical burst damage.
classes.lore: Sable catalogued forbidden bell harmonics before the quarantine. The cure and the curse now share the same notebook.

abilities.name: Binding Sigil
abilities.description: Damage enemies and slow ordinary enemies by 55% within a sigil.

abilities.name: Ward Detonation
abilities.description: Detonate a ward around the aim point and grant nearby allies a 35-health shield.

ultimate.name: Silent Twelfth
ultimate.description: Release three 120-damage pulses over 3 seconds, erase hostile projectiles in range on the first pulse and strongly slow ordinary enemies.

classes.name: Engineer
classes.lore: Tamsin repairs tools with parts that were never meant to fit. She believes the city can be repaired by the same method.

abilities.name: Rivet Turret
abilities.description: Deploy an 80-health turret with 25 base damage per second.

abilities.name: Deployable Barricade
abilities.description: Deploy a 120-health bullet barrier; teammates can pass through it.

ultimate.name: Impossible Machine
ultimate.description: Deploy a 200-health siege construct dealing 90 base damage per second for 14 seconds and overclock owned turrets by 50%.

classes.name: Assassin
classes.role: Precision, mobility and safe rescue openings.
classes.lore: Vale used to carry letters through streets the watch had abandoned. They still know which alleys lead home.

abilities.name: Invisibility
abilities.description: Become untargetable by newly aimed attacks. Existing hazards still hurt.

abilities.name: Shadow Step
abilities.description: Blink toward the aim point, briefly evade damage and strike nearby enemies.

ultimate.name: Unwritten Passage
ultimate.description: For 5 seconds gain three free empowered Shadow Steps, 100% critical chance and untargetability to new aimed attacks. Existing hazards remain dangerous outside dodge invulnerability.

classes.name: Bard
classes.role: Cadenced note fire, close support and selective projectile control.
classes.lore: Iven Cair spent years moving scenery for other people's performances. Newly admitted to the Bard discipline, he is learning to leave a pause long enough for someone else to answer.

abilities.name: Resolving Phrase
abilities.description: Spend up to 3 cadence for three moving pulses, 0.75 seconds apart. Each deals 20 + 5 per cadence damage, slows ordinary enemies by 25%, and refreshes nearby allies' shield to 6 + 3 per cadence for 2 seconds. Shields use the strongest value and respect difficulty limits.

abilities.name: Cut In
abilities.description: Strike along a narrow line toward the aim point, stopping at cover. Deal 65 damage and erase up to 8 hostile projectiles on that line. Warnings, beams, fields and already chosen attack positions are unchanged.

ultimate.name: Encore
ultimate.description: Spend cadence to place a six-pulse performance at your feet. One pulse each second deals 36 + 4 per cadence damage and refreshes 18 + 2 per cadence shield for nearby allies. The stage stays in place. It does not heal, revive, erase hazards or stack identical shields.

classes.name: Swordsman
classes.role: Committed sword cuts, measured advances and bounded frontal counters.
classes.lore: Dara worked at a grinding bench before beginning sword training. She can judge an edge more easily than she can admit she has misjudged a distance.

abilities.name: Measured Cut
abilities.description: Commit for 0.2 seconds on the chosen aim, then advance up to 90 units through clear ground and cut for 75 damage within 130 units. Cover blocks the movement and blade. Dodging cancels the committed cut; this grants no invulnerability.

abilities.name: Frontal Guard
abilities.description: Hold the chosen frontal guard for 11 ticks, stopping at most 3 incoming projectiles at the blade. A real parry opens a 3-second counter: the next committed primary cut deals 60% more damage. Beams, fields, melee damage and existing warnings remain dangerous. Dodging cancels the guard.

ultimate.name: Long Measure
ultimate.description: For 7 seconds, the next 3 committed primary cuts gain 40 reach and 35% damage. Misses and cancelled cuts spend their charge. This is an attack stance, not automatic damage, projectile reflection or invulnerability.

classes.name: Summoner
classes.role: Call a bounded retinue, mark its work and keep its members alive through orders and physical recall.
classes.lore: Joss organized market deliveries before entering Summoner training. He remembers promises more easily than he remembers to leave enough time to keep them.

abilities.name: Call Retinue
abilities.description: Call one Tatterhound and one Lanternwing into clear nearby space, up to four permanent companions. Existing companions keep their health. A full or blocked call spends no cooldown. Companions have real health, movement and attacks; they disappear with their owner or encounter.

abilities.name: Gather
abilities.description: For four seconds, send the living retinue physically back to you at 40% extra movement speed. Each companion present at the cast can recover 12 base health once after arriving. No teleport, resurrection, repeated-arrival healing or invulnerability.

ultimate.name: Open Muster
ultimate.description: Call up to two temporary Wickerwards for 16 seconds and strengthen retinue damage by 25% for that interval. Bodies obey the same health, cover, orders and eight-companion owner limit. Expiration removes temporary forms without an explosion or refund.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.role: Aim-locked bow draws, prepared triplines and limited firing positions.
classes.lore: Nela copied water-survey routes before beginning Ranger training. She is learning that a path drawn on paper can still fail the person who has to use it.

abilities.name: Drawn Line
abilities.description: Spend one ready arrow and hold the chosen aim for 0.4 seconds, moving at 55% speed. Release a real 95-damage arrow with 2 pierce and 980 range. Dodging cancels the release without refunding the arrow or cooldown. Cover stops the arrow.

abilities.name: Tripline
abilities.description: Place a finite cable through legal ground. After 0.8 seconds it can catch an actual enemy crossing, deal 45 damage and slow ordinary enemies by 40% for 3 seconds. A cable lasts 20 active seconds; at most 2 are placed initially. Bosses take damage without a root or attack cancellation. Full or blocked placements spend no cooldown.

ultimate.name: Surveyor's Circuit
ultimate.description: Prepare up to two legal fixed firing positions for 8 seconds. Within 34 units, each position empowers 3 committed primary arrows with 60% damage and 1 pierce. Spend the nearest position's charge when drawing, including cancelled shots. Moving away gives no boost; casting alone deals no damage or invulnerability.

classes.name: Alchemist
classes.role: Prepare finite recipes, place delayed flasks and combine your own mixtures.
classes.lore: Perrin worked in a dyehouse before entering Alchemist training. They trust a repeatable result more readily than a confident explanation, and still keep notes on the batches that went wrong.

abilities.name: Small Batch
abilities.description: Reserve the selected recipe ingredients and brew for 0.4 seconds at 80% movement. Keep up to two recipe-locked vials. Dodging cancels the brew without refund. Flare costs cinder and chalk; Binding costs chalk and sap; Mending costs cinder and sap. Each costs one of both ingredients.

abilities.name: Cast Flask
abilities.description: Throw the oldest prepared vial at a chosen point up to 300 units away, including close or self placement. It lands after 0.5 seconds. Flare deals 55 damage; its eight-second pool adds five 4-damage pulses, one every 1.5 seconds. Binding deals 25 and slows ordinary enemies by 40% for three seconds, with five brief slow refreshes in its eight-second pool. Mending restores 18 missing health. Cover blocks placement and splash. Your Flare can consume your Binding pool for 30 extra impact damage; Mending can consume your fire pool without extra healing, forfeiting its remaining pulses.

ultimate.name: Standard Batch
ultimate.description: Restore one of each combat ingredient, up to six each. For fourteen seconds your next three actual throws gain 50% potency and 25% radius. Begin with prepared vials and a ready throw to use the full batch at base cooldown. A miss spends its charge. Casting alone deals no damage and grants no invulnerability.

bosses.name: Hollow Constable
bosses.lore: A dead watch captain remembers every order except whom it was meant to protect.

signature.behavior: Patrol shuffles between locked double volleys; Cordon fires crossing flank fans and a line of arrest stamps; Lockdown pursues while releasing staggered rings with a shared escape wedge. Brutal adds a third ring in Curfew.
signature.counterplay: Move after aim locks. Cross between the Cordon fans, leave the arrest outlines, and follow the overlapping open wedge in the Lockdown rings. Casting plants his feet; successful Accords interrupt pending volleys and give a full stagger window.

bosses.artBrief: A dead watch captain remembers every order except whom it was meant to protect. One dominant silhouette and one signature prop; quiet matte fabric masses, restrained surface detail.

bosses.name: Carrion Courier
bosses.lore: A messenger runs the same route after the streets and their names have disappeared.

signature.behavior: A single locked delivery becomes a two-leg return route at half health. Every new leg warns from the actual stop. Advanced forms add one leg and a delayed split dispatch fan.
signature.counterplay: Step sideways from each fixed charge lane, read the next arrow after the stop, and punish recovery. Wait for fading trails; the advanced dispatch fan leaves its marked central wedge clear.

bosses.name: Pallbearer
bosses.lore: The coffin is empty. Its bearer keeps making room.

signature.behavior: Advance behind a resistant coffin front and moving cover, then commit to a long straight charge.
signature.counterplay: Flank the coffin, use the moving cover against volleys and attack during the charge recovery.

bosses.artBrief: The coffin is empty. Its bearer keeps making room. One dominant silhouette and one signature prop; quiet matte fabric masses, restrained surface detail.

bosses.name: Cradle Matron
bosses.lore: An infirmary keeper shelters the dead beneath a dress sewn from bed linen.

signature.behavior: Hushed Ward escorts a marked new nest along a connected body-clear route, then calls one gapped lullaby. Cradle Relay moves to the other flank and relays numbered lullabies through surviving nests. Early/late broods have two/four navigating minions, with the existing eighteen-actor cap. Brutal adds thirty separately warned alternating-port needles per calling nest. Crazed retains that prefix and adds sixty crossing needles.
signature.counterplay: Read the harmless pale escort path and the nest growth warning. Broods warn for at least 1.2 seconds; lullabies warn for at least 1.6 seconds and lock an 86-degree gap. Move through the numbered gaps. Destroy nests to stop their future brood and unreleased needles; active rings continue. No surviving nest makes the Matron call alone. All needle headings warn before release and repeated waves remain marked. Actual offset bounds, body width, cover and Hellish lava constrain escort and nest placement. Base combat, art and music remain.

bosses.artBrief: An infirmary keeper shelters the dead beneath a dress sewn from bed linen. One dominant silhouette and one signature prop; quiet matte fabric masses, restrained surface detail.

bosses.name: Mold Alchemist
bosses.lore: A municipal chemist carries a garden that learned to grow without sunlight.

signature.behavior: The Alchemist aims acid and alkali flasks at survivors while walking. Opposite reagents neutralize into coolant. Distillation adds a full-field vapor bank; Thermal Runaway adds pressure vessels that coolant can defuse; advanced Fractionation sends two separately warned banks. Brutal matching reagents couple into cancelable timed eruptions. Crazed adds catalyst flasks that spend coolant or cause a freshly warned eruption in unmixed reagents. Generic bullet fans, vial-needle sprays and common Crazed laser pressure are replaced by owned chemistry techniques. Crazed distillation columns add independently warned aerosol lanes while ordinary recipes continue: fixed first-phase trains, later fresh aiming, two staggered sources and final inward reflux.
signature.counterplay: Amber triangles mark acid and blue squares mark alkali. Both harm and slow. Bait the opposite flask close to an existing pool, then leave; the mixture clears reagents and makes pale coolant. Coolant opens a visible gap in vapor and cools nearby pressure vessels before rupture. Dash across a vapor bank when coolant is unavailable. Neutralize either member of a Brutal coupled pair before its first eruption. Bait a Crazed catalyst into coolant to quench it, spending the coolant; unmixed reagents create a fresh warned blast. Every flask locks its landing for 1.4 seconds. Three Standard/four advanced phases, base combat, fixed grade, individual theme and old action art remain; eight newly drawn walking poses are added. Crazed columns cool when mixed coolant reaches their base, canceling future and pending releases. Already released clouds keep their locked path until expiry or coolant contact. Coolant condenses one or more clouds during its0.9-second spent grace; clouds slow and hit once, pass over masonry and warn their complete route for1.8seconds. Apparatus is not shootable.

bosses.name: Bellringer
bosses.lore: Every note is a warning delivered too late.

signature.behavior: Approach a survivor, then perform paired, procession and counterstroke peals with independently aimed clappers. Standard uses wider fixed openings, slower spacing and a shorter clapper reach. Brutal adds one tethered clapper throw with a separately warned return. Crazed keeps the thrown clapper and concurrent responding bell.
signature.counterplay: The approach path is harmless. Standard has a46-degree wave opening; advanced forms retain35degrees. Leave each marked clapper sector. The thrown head follows a locked outbound lane; after landing, shoot its cracked white head during the fresh return warning to break it, or sidestep the returning head. The thin tether itself is harmless. Every peal, swing and throw leg has its own contact budget. Phase entry preserves the issued score; only earned counterplay or natural expiry interrupts it.

bosses.artBrief: Every note is a warning delivered too late. One dominant silhouette and one signature prop; quiet matte fabric masses, restrained surface detail.

bosses.name: Stitchwright
bosses.lore:
A surgeon of uniforms now mends the people who wore them. Before the quarantine, Elian Vey kept a tailoring stall beside the infirmary. People who could not pay left a button in a jar. Vey remembered their names by the cloth they brought: the courier’s blue cuff, the watchwoman’s coat, the little yellow sleeve that needed lengthening each spring.

When the council ordered every household sewn into the civic register, the stall became a checkpoint. Vey was told to stitch numbered tags into evacuation clothes. Those without a number were turned back. On the final night, Vey cut the tags from a basket of children’s coats and sewed the doors shut behind the fleeing families. The bells found a person still holding a needle.

Now the Stitchwright tries to repair every gap, even the spaces living people need to breathe. A cut thread briefly breaks the old command. Under the last hem lies the button jar, its lid marked in a cramped hand: No account required. Iona recognizes the yellow sleeve. She takes it to the gate, where there is still someone waiting for it.

signature.behavior: A harmless short approach leads to locked, destructible needle seams. Basting Line lays one thread; Backstitch returns along surviving needles after a fresh warning and adds the existing rescue tether. Closing Hem contracts three sides around a clear patch with one permanently open escape side. Last Alteration uses two sequential hems. Crazed adds its own warned crossing stitch; it never closes the hem escape while the hem is active.
signature.counterplay: Leave dashed thread warnings before they become solid; each stroke can hit once. Shoot either needle to sever all threads attached to it, including pending backstitches. Escape a closing hem through the hollow arrow or destroy a needle. Existing tethers can still be shot or released by one second of interaction. The original art and theme remain; these are new shared-authority techniques, not new directional animation.

signature.behavior: Three coordinated casters offset their beam casts, leaving a readable sequence between the individual releases.
signature.counterplay: Track the three numbered caster tells and move between locked beam directions; attacks remain visible without sound.

signature.behavior: Alternate armored firing cycles with an exposed weak point while ordered lanes and broad fans cover the floor.
signature.counterplay: Aim at the outlined weak point, use the firing gaps and save burst damage for the exposed cycle.

signature.behavior: Shift flooded ground and relocate among harmless decoys before announcing the true ring and pool attacks.
signature.counterplay: Follow the solid true-body marker, use dry paths and wait for the relocation tell before committing a dodge.

signature.behavior: Combine ledger echoes, announced relocations, offset beams and bounded summons after the campaign victory is banked.
signature.counterplay: Use the persistent echo warnings and wide final ring gap, clear nearby summons and treat the extension as a separate challenge.

bosses.name: The Tollkeeper
bosses.lore: A corpse toll collector crouched behind one enormous coin wheel. The quarantine left its work unfinished.
bosses.artBrief: A corpse toll collector crouched behind one enormous coin wheel. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Exact Fare warns a complete one-reflection wheel route. Closing Booth shifts position, rolls to a bank, stops, then locks a fresh return toward a survivor. Advanced forms warn side sprays at banks and add a third late leg.
signature.counterplay: Leave the locked wheel line and cross behind the passing wheel. In Closing Booth read the new arrow after its bank stop; it cannot track you after warning. Advanced side sprays warn separately from the wheel lane. Punish the clear recovery.

signature.counterplay: Read the sweep-direction arrow, move behind the cone, and follow the new ground origin after a patrol. The final Brutal return sweep has its own complete warning and never overlaps the first.

bosses.name: Quarantine Clerk
bosses.lore: A thin undead clerk carrying a broad folded ledger and red sealing stamp. The quarantine left its work unfinished.
bosses.artBrief: A thin undead clerk carrying a broad folded ledger and red sealing stamp. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Reachable arena-relative stamp centers replace the fixed fallback grid. Standard reopens I early and III late. Brutal chooses one random green number at the start of phase one, holds it throughout that phase and chooses a new random number for each phase-two batch; Crazed chooses a randomly numbered seal in every field. The choice locks and warns with the full field, before any strike. The late Appeal Circuit patrols before marking. Standard uses three red/green stamps, Brutal five including doubled-damage purple stamps, and Crazed ten including black current-health curses. Advanced late appeals replace the expired set after a gap, keeping the live field capped at five/ten. Each reopening precedes a locked, fully warned volley from two/three/four marked origins by form; the green seal visibly absorbs shots at its rim.
signature.counterplay: Active green shelter also increases damage to the Clerk by 50%/35% in Standard, 40%/20% in Brutal and 25%/5% in Crazed (early/late). Crazed phase two leaves two amber infinity domains after each stamp batch. After a separate two-second warning, they remain for the rest of combat and remove 10% of maximum health per contact, bypassing armor and shield capacity, at most once per second across overlapping domains. Green shelter and invulnerability protect. Read the ordered marks and the notched future-safe seal. Wait for its green interior before entering. Follow the new ground origin after a late patrol; advanced appeals warn a fresh set after the old field expires. Purple stamps hit twice as hard as red. The first successful purple contact per player per seal also removes 15% of current health, bypassing armor/shield capacity, and applies three seconds of nonstacking poison (two base damage each half-second) and 35% walking slow; dash speed remains unchanged. Cleanse supplies and Medic cleansing abilities remove both. Green shelter and invulnerability prevent application and poison ticks. Brutal shelter lasts at least 3.5 seconds and Crazed at least five seconds, extending if needed until half a second after the final possible fan echo reaches the rim; black stamps remove 75% of current health once per seal activation, bypassing armor/shields but respecting invulnerability and green protection, leaving at least one health. Shape markings distinguish hazards. The shield outline and closing rim identify temporary shelter from marked volleys; use it to keep firing, or dodge the warned fan in open ground.

bosses.artBrief: A dead gate marshal in a rectangular iron coat carrying two heavy chains. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Held Line plants two clear reachable anchors and warns opposite locked sweeps. At half health, Shifting Writ marks a lateral reposition before placing new anchors, staggers the arms and gives each surviving anchor a freshly aimed reverse sweep after a full new warning. Actual bounds and masonry clip the warned sweep envelope. Advanced anchors warn gapped barb volleys; Crazed later repeats add separately warned crossing angles.
signature.counterplay: Find the numbered anchors before the sweep. Leave the painted sweep, cross behind the passing arm or shoot an anchor to cut only its chain, return and unreleased barb repeats. In-flight shots remain. New phase-two headings lock only when the return warning appears. Every arm gets a complete 1.4-second tell, including the return. Clear masonry blocks the physical chain. Barbs have their own warning and gap; the chain still crosses that gap. Punish the explicit recovery. Anchor health remains 90 Standard/180 advanced; base boss health, damage, timer and grade remain.

bosses.name: Gate Widow
bosses.lore: A mourning corpse whose veil is a single large gate-shaped iron frame. The quarantine left its work unfinished.
bosses.artBrief: A mourning corpse whose veil is a single large gate-shaped iron frame. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Three Latches warns two closed lanes and an open numbered crossing. A moving floor pall sweeps the two closed-lane tracks toward the locked target side. At half health, Crossed Threshold marks a real reposition, then warns a vertical gate and a separate horizontal return. Brutal adds gapped latch needles; Crazed retains them, adds crossing needle repeats and one additional separately warned gate.
signature.counterplay: Follow the open numbered lane to cross the gate or avoid the moving floor pall; a timed dash can also cross the pall. The gap is not a bullet shield. Floor sweeps pass under masonry. Every gate gets a full 1.5-second tell, and the pall starts another 0.6 seconds later. Only one gate set can be solid at a time; the next orientation waits for the old set and an exit interval. Read each fresh locked warning and attack in recovery. Original boss health, damage, deadline, attack definitions, fixed grade, art and Third Latch score remain.

bosses.name: Black Ambulance
bosses.lore: A horse-shaped mortuary ambulance fused to its skeletal driver and one bell. The quarantine left its work unfinished.
bosses.artBrief: A horse-shaped mortuary ambulance fused to its skeletal driver and one bell. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Last Call follows a connected, body-clear perimeter route before one locked rescue-lane charge. At half health, Second Dispatch patrols in the other direction and gives two separately warned headings. Brutal adds one dispatch per sequence and warned gapped door volleys at every stop. Crazed keeps the full Brutal sequence and adds a fourth late dispatch with crossing door repeats.
signature.counterplay: The gold patrol route is harmless. Leave the marked road during its full 1.4-second warning; aim locks before the body moves. Each late heading is warned from its actual new stop. Advanced door fans warn for at least 1.25 seconds and mark all distinct repeat headings; move through their gaps and read the remaining-wave marks before the next departure. The last stop exposes the driver for three seconds and grants the existing 25% boss-damage bonus. Actual map offsets, body width, cover and Hellish lava constrain both route and charge. No instant-kill attack or new art is added.

bosses.name: Glass Surgeon
bosses.lore: Dr. Oren Pell ground lenses for the city infirmary. Ordered to certify patients by the color of their eyes, he shattered the council’s measuring glass instead. The arm he rebuilt from its fragments still searches for a diagnosis that cannot become a sentence.
bosses.artBrief: A slender corpse surgeon with one transparent glass arm and an ivory apron. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Shootable mirror lenses lock branching refraction rays. Diagnostic, relay and forked optical casts change the route; advanced returns and a separately warned Crazed incision leave time between pulses.
signature.counterplay: Read the complete dashed path. Move away before it becomes solid or shoot a lens to disable every segment linked to it. Rays pass through cover. Each pulse hits once; no mobility purchase is required.

bosses.name: Ash Baker
bosses.lore: Edda Marr baked for the night shift before the council counted flour as furnace fuel. She fed the people outside the cordon from a second set of books, recording portions instead of debts. The order to keep the ovens hot outlived her. The oven in her chest still measures a batch by the number of names waiting for it.
bosses.artBrief: A broad dead baker with a shovel and a single round brick-oven torso. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Locked rolling batches land as shootable crusts. Freshly warned crumbs open forked or scored routes; the fourth advanced phase leaves an open center before its three-way split. Brutal and Crazed add independently warned later batches.
signature.counterplay: Leave the rolling body path during its full warning. Shoot a landed crust before its timer ends to cancel its crumbs, or follow the newly warned gaps. One batch can hit each survivor once. Short harmless approaches happen only between complete batches.

bosses.name: Sluice Keeper
bosses.lore: Ressa Noll kept the river gates before the council turned flood levels into a list of permitted streets. She opened a relief valve when the lower wards were ordered to wait. The order shut her pump house with her inside it. Her dead hands still test every wheel for the one that can let the city breathe.
bosses.artBrief: A drowned municipal worker hauling one circular floodgate on his back. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Bounded currents carry freshly warned moving crests. Shootable valves drain only their own lane and cancel its crest. Paired channels, alternating weaves and a crossed final pressure change the route; advanced returns retain their issuing phase.
signature.counterplay: The blue water pushes without dealing contact damage. Only the moving crest hurts, after its own full warning. Step onto a dry bank or shoot its valve. Crests wash through cover. Destroying one valve leaves other channels active; no General purchase is required.

bosses.name: Last Stationmaster
bosses.lore: Neris Vale held the last train while the council ordered the lower platform sealed. She counted the wounded aboard instead of checking their permits. The departure bell rang after the gates closed, but no arrival was ever recorded. Her signal still promises one clear track to anyone willing to cross the platform.
bosses.artBrief: A rigid dead conductor with a huge ticket punch and broad signal flags. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Bounded train dispatches change from paired tracks to a rotating three-track timetable, then freshly warned crossings. Every wave retains an open track. Shootable signals can open another track; advanced returns retain their issuing phase.
signature.counterplay: Arrows mark an open track; crosses mark an incoming train. Each wave warns for two seconds. Only the visible moving car hurts, once per entire dispatch, including its later crossing. Leave its path or shoot its signal. Trains pass through cover. No General purchase is required.

bosses.name: The Lamplighter
bosses.lore: Tavin Orr inspected Lorn's street lamps and signed off on its three-lamp standard. Night nurses brought him sketches of the blind corners between them; he filed the sketches as complaints about the dark. On his last round he moved one lamp to the infirmary road, then wrote the approved spacing in his report. His ladder still offers refuges by a rule he learned to bend in private.
bosses.artBrief: A long-limbed corpse carrying a three-pronged civic candle ladder. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Three shootable civic candles cast reachable refuges for active survivors. Static shelters become moving shadows, a double watch and a final triple watch. Breaking a candle banks and widens only its linked announced refuges. Advanced echoes retain their issuing phase and receive new warnings.
signature.counterplay: Reach a white outlined destination before the full 2.8-second warning ends. Shadows stop moving before the pulse. Match a candle’s marks to its refuges; breaking it anchors and widens their promised destination. Only lamp pulses are blocked by these refuges; lava and other hazards still hurt. Crossing an exposed gap during a pulse can hit once, even if both endpoints are safe. No General purchase is required.

bosses.name: Folded Man
bosses.lore: An angular corpse folded into one large paper-coat silhouette with a black seam. The quarantine left its work unfinished.
bosses.artBrief: An angular corpse folded into one large paper-coat silhouette with a black seam. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Fold a visible line across the floor; bullets cross the line at a mirrored angle after a long warning.
signature.counterplay: Use the permanently unreflected side; predicted paths show both entry and exit directions.

bosses.name: Red Comet
bosses.lore: A dead meteor courier wrapped in one broad red scarf and a long tapered brass shell. The quarantine left its work unfinished.
bosses.artBrief: A dead meteor courier wrapped in one broad red scarf and a long tapered brass shell. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Dash through three fixed waypoints, leaving trails that go harmless in the order they were created.
signature.counterplay: Follow the numbered path and cross the oldest faded trail.

bosses.name: Memory Taxer
bosses.lore: A blind corpse assessor carrying one large empty portrait frame and a square ledger bag. The quarantine left its work unfinished.
bosses.artBrief: A blind corpse assessor carrying one large empty portrait frame and a square ledger bag. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Show three large safe-pad symbols, then request the first shown symbol before a bounded outside pulse.
signature.counterplay: Use the numbered visual history that stays on the HUD; memorization is optional and accessible.

bosses.name: Choir of Moths
bosses.lore: A silent corpse singer in one wide moth-wing shawl with three large ivory eye shapes. The quarantine left its work unfinished.
bosses.artBrief: A silent corpse singer in one wide moth-wing shawl with three large ivory eye shapes. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Release three cohesive moth ribbons along curved paths; one ribbon visibly breaks to create a crossing.
signature.counterplay: Cross at the broken ribbon and ignore decorative wing dust, which is not generated.

bosses.name: Zero-Hour Conductor
bosses.lore: A dead conductor with a broad metronome torso and one long baton. The quarantine left its work unfinished.
bosses.artBrief: A dead conductor with a broad metronome torso and one long baton. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Count four visible beats and release one alternating lane pattern on each beat with a fixed safe syncopation.
signature.counterplay: Read the persistent beat pips and safe lane marker; audio rhythm is never required.

bosses.name: Walking District
bosses.lore: A monumental corpse bent around three broad civic roof shapes and one central bell. The quarantine left its work unfinished.
bosses.artBrief: A monumental corpse bent around three broad civic roof shapes and one central bell. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Lift two temporary building blocks and shift them along outlined lanes, exposing one large central weak point.
signature.counterplay: Use the broad outer bypass or the cleared central path after the blocks settle.

bosses.name: The Last Knocker
bosses.lore: A faceless corpse carrying one immense upright front door and a single brass knocker. The quarantine left its work unfinished.
bosses.artBrief: A faceless corpse carrying one immense upright front door and a single brass knocker. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Knock three times before the door swings through a marked sector; the opposite sector remains open.
signature.counterplay: Follow the three visible knocks and move behind the hinge; attack during the open-door recovery.

bosses.name: Ashen Usher
bosses.lore: Still seats visitors in a hall no one can find.

signature.behavior: Breakable ticket stands release staggered aisle volleys. Dismissal crosses the rows; Final Call adds a second sweep while the usher walks between calls.
signature.counterplay: Read the locked rays and cross after a volley, or destroy a ticket stand to cancel every pending shot from that stand.

bosses.artBrief: Still seats visitors in a hall no one can find. Preserve the issued original concept and complete motion poses.

bosses.name: Brass Toad
bosses.lore: The abandoned fountain learned to drink the rain.

signature.behavior: Locked landing circles precede physical hops and gapped ripple projectiles. Downpour adds a second landing; Dry Mouth follows with a narrow tongue lane.
signature.counterplay: Leave the landing circles, cross the broad ripple wedge and sidestep the locked tongue line. Breaking the drain plug cancels its tongue jet.

bosses.artBrief: The abandoned fountain learned to drink the rain. Preserve the issued original concept and complete motion poses.

bosses.name: Ragpicker's Kite
bosses.lore: Its tether still pulls above a deserted street.

signature.behavior: A floating orbit surrounds warned wind corridors. Crosswind adds opposing corridors with a quiet center; Unravelling staggers three wing fans.
signature.counterplay: Use the quiet center, steer against the marked arrows or break a cloth pin to remove its wind. Dodge briefly suppresses wind force.

bosses.artBrief: Its tether still pulls above a deserted street. Preserve the issued original concept and complete motion poses.

bosses.name: Candle Snail
bosses.lore: A single light still travels the cemetery path.

signature.behavior: A slow collision-resolved glide lays locked warned wax rails. Twin Wick adds parallel rails with a quiet center and faster lateral movement.
signature.counterplay: Leave the marked wake before it burns, cross after it cools, or use the quiet center between twin rails. Masonry stops the wake.

bosses.artBrief: A single light still travels the cemetery path. Preserve the selected original motion, permanent identity marks and complete defeat poses.

bosses.name: Cobble Crab
bosses.lore: The street gathers its loose stones at the sound of footsteps.

signature.behavior: Warned stone pincers physically close toward a locked strip while the crab scuttles sideways. Cross Streets alternates axes and adds a second closure.
signature.counterplay: Leave the closing jaws or break their linked finite anchor stone. Pass through after a clamp; the outer lanes remain open.

bosses.artBrief: The street gathers its loose stones at the sound of footsteps. Preserve the selected original motion, permanent identity marks and complete defeat poses.

bosses.name: Mourning Kettle
bosses.lore: It keeps the last tea warm for guests who never returned.

signature.behavior: A marked steam lane pours before crossing condensation beads. Last Service staggers two separated lanes while the kettle waddles between casts.
signature.counterplay: Sidestep the warning, cross after steam ends or break a finite remote valve to cancel its linked pour and beads. Preserve a cold route.

bosses.artBrief: It keeps the last tea warm for guests who never returned. Preserve the selected original motion, permanent identity marks and complete defeat poses.

leaderboards.status: Stage 1 specification; no online implementation or service deployment is implied
leaderboards.teamRankPolicy: Every combat participant shares the one team-run rank. Personal contributions never establish individual ranks.

periods.all: All qualifying terminal runs within the selected release season and exact content revision.

week.explicitWeekStart: YYYY-MM-DD Monday; reject any other weekday or time zone.

seasons.contentPolicy: Exact content revision partitions scores. Preserve older seasons as archives; never silently merge balance revisions.

rosterPolicy.identity: Server-minted opaque run-scoped UUID; a reconnect retains its original participantId.
rosterPolicy.admission: Only at encounter boundaries. Spectators and lobby-only visitors are excluded.
rosterPolicy.finalEligibleRoster: Union of every unique participant admitted into combat from the first encounter through the scored clear. Departures, kicks, and eliminations never remove members.
rosterPolicy.survivorsAtFinalClear: Eligible participants alive, connected and admitted to combat at the authoritative base final-clear tick.
rosterPolicy.peakCombatRoster: Maximum concurrent admitted combat slots at any encounter start, including downed, eliminated and reconnect-reserved slots.
rosterPolicy.lateJoinCredit: Same team rank, with encounter entry/range, participation and final-state context.

timed.eligibleOutcome: Completed required base encounters; each clears before its own deadline; at least one connected living survivor.
timed.formula: roundHalfUp(500000 + 250000 * clamp(1 - combatMs / deadlineBudgetMs, 0, 1) + 150000 * survivorsAtFinalClear / finalEligibleRoster + 100000 * clamp(1 - hpDamageTaken / summedPlayerMaxHealthAtEncounterStarts, 0, 1))
timed.rounding: Round complete nonnegative sum once: floor(x + 0.5). Use exact integer-ratio arithmetic at rounding boundaries.

finalEligibleRoster.meaning: All unique participants ever admitted into scored combat; departures remain eligible.

timed.healthDamage: Actual HP removed, including hostile/environmental/self-damage; cap each hit at remaining HP. Exclude shield depletion, blocked damage, max-health-stat changes and overkill; healing never subtracts damage.
timed.healthBudget: Sum effective maximum HP once per admitted entrant per scored encounter start. Revives/reconnects/shields never add extra budget.
timed.deadlineBudget: Sum frozen per-encounter authored deadlines after legal difficulty/mutation adjustments; validate every individual clear.
timed.clock: Active simulation from first combat through base final clear, including telegraphs/Accord/phase invulnerability. Exclude all noncombat phases.
timed.secretPolicy: Finalize and bank base campaign rank before optional Uncounted. Secret result is a badge and cannot alter base score.

endless.clock: Only active combat ticks; freeze rank tuple after each completed boss. Show total active survival including final failed encounter.

finalEligibleRoster.meaning: All historical admitted combat participants; can exceed 50 because peak concurrency is separate.

endless.partialEncounterPolicy: Additional survival/damage after last clear stays in recap but cannot improve the ranking tuple.

ties.ratioComparison: Cross-multiply with arbitrary-precision integers; never compare rounded display percentages.

rankedEligibility.trustedSource: Official authoritative Render combat server authenticated to the Sites HTTP service.
rankedEligibility.privateOptIn: Explicit before first combat, disclosed to every lobby participant: results and nicknames become public; private room code remains private.
rankedEligibility.accessibility: Aim assist, auto-fire, remapping, touch, gamepad and reduced effects remain ranked-compatible.

storage.migrationPolicy: Append versioned schema-only migrations; no runtime CREATE/ALTER.

runs.index: Exact board partition, competitive keys, terminal time

participants.fields: Public roster fields plus private admission counters; never reconnect secrets.

storage.mutationAtomicity: One D1 batch with constrained compare-and-set, event idempotency and all participant deltas. Failed state/owner/sequence checks must abort dependent writes.
storage.rankedContentRegistry: Server configuration allowlists exact protocol/content/rules/season combinations; requests cannot create trusted combinations.

exactRatioIndex.formula: BigInt floor(numerator * 10^33 / denominator), left-pad to 49 decimal digits
exactRatioIndex.proof: Any two distinct permitted fractions differ by at least 1/(2^53-1)^2; scaling by 10^33 separates them by more than 12, preserving exact ordering after floor. Equal fractions produce equal keys.
exactRatioIndex.indexPolicy: Use this key in the competitive ordering index and RANK window. Never SQLite floating division or rounded percentages.

authentication.canonicalRequest: UPPERCASE_METHOD + LF + PATH + LF + timestamp + LF + nonce + LF + SHA256_HEX(exactBodyBytes)
authentication.pathPolicy: No writer query strings. Sign the normalized literal /api/v1/ path.
authentication.verification: Web Crypto verify; configured official key/server allowlist; never keys from a request body.
authentication.rotation: Current key plus one configured previous key for a 24-hour transition.

http.numericPolicy: All counters are nonnegative safe integers. Positive denominators and validated enum values. Reject NaN, infinity, booleans-as-integers and unknown keys.

errors.400: Invalid shape, enum, numeric range or board combination

semanticValidation: Participant display names also require NFC/trim/grapheme/UTF-8/control checks; JSON Schema length alone is insufficient.
survivorsAtFinalClear <= min(finalEligibleRoster, peakCombatRoster); finalEligibleRoster equals registered historical roster count.
peakCombatRoster <= mode capacity and <= finalEligibleRoster. Derive the band; reject any caller-provided different band.
combatMs == floor(combatTicks * 1000 / 30); use arbitrary-precision integer intermediate products.
For Endless, totalCombatSurvivalTicks >= combatThroughLastClearTicks; both derived ms values must agree with ticks.
Every required individual timed encounter clears strictly before its frozen deadline; aggregate combatMs alone is insufficient evidence.
Timed final metrics are accepted only for timed modes and exact required encounter count; Endless metrics only for endless mode with >=1 clear.
Cumulative damage, elapsed combat, health budget, clears, roster count and peak cannot decrease across registered events.
Last-clear metrics freeze at the latest acknowledged clear and must match final Endless metrics.
Every participant delta uses an admitted run-scoped ID, valid class IDs, nondecreasing contribution totals and legal encounter bounds.
finalize terminalReason base-clear is valid only for timed clears; other terminal reasons are valid only for Endless global entries.
Run/event UUIDs are lowercase UUIDv4. Private checkpoint digests are never public API fields.
Week membership uses the signed authoritative terminal time; idempotent retries do not move a result between weeks.

combat-start.precondition: registered or intermission; exact current sequence/digest/owner; roster durably registered
combat-start.effect: Set phase combat before simulating any tick; keep checkpoint sequence; refresh owner lease.

intermission.precondition: combat clear or intermission bounded roster registration; exact current sequence/digest/owner
intermission.effect: Set intermission; increment checkpoint sequence; replace digest; preserve monotonic counters.

lease-refresh.precondition: Nonterminal eligible run; exact current sequence/digest/owner
lease-refresh.effect: Set owner lease expiry to service now + 90 seconds. No gameplay/sequence change.

restore-claim.precondition: Latest acknowledged intermission digest; the official server validates the signed checkpoint and <=24h lifetime before requesting the claim; prior 90-second lease expired; exact sequence/digest.
restore-claim.effect: Atomically increment ownerEpoch and replace server ownership. No counter/seed/offer reroll; one claimant wins.

demote.effect: Latch verificationState unverified or practice. Never allow later promotion.

finalize.precondition: Current owner, exact sequence/state/digest; completed timed clear or terminal endless with >=1 clear; all participants durably registered
finalize.effect: Compute derived score/band/rank keys; atomically mark terminal and persist one immutable result.

checkpointIntegrity.rankedRecovery: Only exact latest durable intermission, atomically claimed by one owner after lease expiry; no finished run, old sequence or active-combat replay.
checkpointIntegrity.midCombatCrashRecovery: Resume signed prior checkpoint as Recovery Practice. Cannot erase failed partial combat for a better verified result.
checkpointIntegrity.idempotentFinalize: Same run/event/payload hash returns original result with no second row. Conflicting payload or terminal replay is 409.
checkpointIntegrity.serviceFailure: Continue gameplay. Latch unverified if a required registration cannot be acknowledged; never block offline/LAN gameplay.
checkpointIntegrity.unknownFinalizeResponse: Pending verification; owning official server retries exact event with fresh transport nonce for <=24h. Lost unacknowledged payload never becomes an invented rank.
checkpointIntegrity.leaseTransfer: No early-release endpoint in v1. A replacement owner waits for the 90-second lease to expire; planned shutdown can stop refreshing it.

ui.mobile: Two-line rows; explicit expand button; no horizontal scrolling.
ui.rtl: Mirror menus while preserving rank/number direction and isolating nicknames.
