storyCampaign.title: The Open Ledger
storyCampaign.intro: Lorn's council has announced that the evacuation is complete. Mara Rook can still hear people behind the gate. The dead at the wheel are obeying an old instruction, and eleven bells repeat it across the city. A twelfth bell has no name. Enter the cordon, find the people the ledger left out, and decide what the city should remember.

acts.title: A way inside
acts.speaker: Mara Rook
acts.text: The first task is small enough to say aloud: open a door and bring someone through it. The gate will lead to a ward, a workshop and a list. The order in which we reach them matters.

acts.title: The work of the living
acts.speaker: Tamsin Reed
acts.text: The city still works. Ovens burn, clocks turn and pumps empty the river into the streets. Their operators are dead. Somewhere a command is being copied faster than we can break it.

acts.title: Everyone has a name
acts.speaker: Sable Quill
acts.text: The council's final bell does not command the dead to rise. It tells them whom to ignore. We have followed the order to its source. Now we must choose what will replace it.

beats.title: The hinge
beats.speaker: Mara Rook
beats.text: The gate stops repeating its lock order. Beneath the wheel we find a brass plate: EVACUATION COMPLETE. Fresh chalk names cover the wall below it. Someone inside the cordon has been keeping a different account.

choices.title: Bring out the families
choices.text: Make room for the people waiting at the triage passage.

choices.title: Copy the chalk names
choices.text: Take a witness list through the old registry gate.

choices.title: Cut the alarm wire
choices.text: Break the signal that keeps the workshops sealed.

beats.title: Three addresses
beats.speaker: Iona Vale
beats.text: A porter gives us three addresses and only one unbroken handcart. One holds patients, one holds their admission slips, and one holds the mechanism that marks the slips refused. We cannot be everywhere at once.

choices.title: Take the cart to the ward
choices.text: Carry blankets and drinking water toward the infirmary.

choices.title: Recover the admission slips
choices.text: Keep proof of who was turned away.

choices.title: Stop the refusal machine
choices.text: Remove the seal before more doors obey it.

beats.title: The red door
beats.speaker: Bram Voss
beats.text: The door is painted red on both sides. The people behind it were told that red meant safety; the watch were told that it meant infection. Bram takes the handle off and carries it with him. There will be no second locking.

choices.title: Escort the people inside
choices.text: Give the slowest walkers a protected route.

choices.title: Find the watch order
choices.text: Read the original instruction rather than another copy.

choices.title: Break the locking gear
choices.text: Make the next red door impossible to close.

beats.title: The measure
beats.speaker: Sable Quill
beats.text: The council called its sorting device a diagnostic instrument. Its scales have no weight marks, only columns for accepted and unlisted. The glass is cracked from the inside. Someone tried to make the result come out differently.

choices.title: Treat the unlisted
choices.text: Take the rejected patients somewhere a form cannot stop them.

choices.title: Keep the broken measure
choices.text: Carry the instrument as evidence of what it was built to do.

choices.title: Destroy the stencil
choices.text: Stop the workshops making another identical scale.

beats.title: No one left outside
beats.speaker: Mara Rook
beats.text: The next cart reaches the gate without an admission stamp. Nothing terrible happens. A child asks why everyone looks surprised. Beyond the wall, the bells begin the next shift. We have opened one door; the city can still close a thousand.

choices.title: Shelter the first convoy
choices.text: Prepare a quiet place for the next group to arrive.

choices.title: Deliver the witness list
choices.text: Let the outer watch see whose names were missing.

choices.title: Follow the shift signal
choices.text: Trace the order back through the working machinery.

beats.title: The bread line
beats.speaker: Hux Bell
beats.text: The ovens are full, but the queue is empty. Hux finds a week's wages tied into a baker's apron. The flour has been counted as fuel. He remembers working hungry beside this furnace, when the bells still called it a privilege.

choices.title: Send the flour to the ward
choices.text: Turn a counted resource into something people can eat.

choices.title: Record the unpaid names
choices.text: Carry the workers' accounts out of the furnace hall.

choices.title: Pull the coal chain
choices.text: Stop the next shift before the furnace can demand it.

beats.title: Unpaid hours
beats.speaker: Tamsin Reed
beats.text: Every clock has kept the same minute. Each time its hand reaches the next mark, a ratchet pulls it back. Tamsin could repair the ratchet with her eyes closed. Instead she asks who benefits from a shift that cannot end.

choices.title: Give the crews a rest
choices.text: Move the trapped workers toward the infirmary courtyard.

choices.title: Take the time sheets
choices.text: Preserve the hours that the clocks refused to finish.

choices.title: Remove the ratchet
choices.text: Let the machines reach tomorrow without another command.

beats.title: The flooded register
beats.speaker: Vale Ash
beats.text: The post bag is too heavy to lift until the water drains from it. Each letter begins with the same apology for being late. Vale finds one addressed to a person who has been helping us since the gate. Nobody has told them the letter arrived.

choices.title: Ferry the waiting families
choices.text: Use the chapel steps as a dry gathering place.

choices.title: Deliver every letter
choices.text: Bring the bag to the registry and find its living addresses.

choices.title: Open the flood controls
choices.text: Cut the command that keeps the streets under water.

beats.title: A reason to sing
beats.speaker: Sable Quill
beats.text: The choir's score has no words. Its rests are marked with tiny names, crossed out one by one. When Sable reads a name into the silence, someone on the far side of the room answers. The bells hesitate for a single beat.

choices.title: Keep a quiet room
choices.text: Make space for the voices that are still frightened to answer.

choices.title: Carry the marked score
choices.text: Keep the erased names beside the witnesses who know them.

choices.title: Disconnect the amplifier
choices.text: Stop the order being made louder than a human voice.

beats.title: The city answers
beats.speaker: Mara Rook
beats.text: Three districts answer the radio without giving a registration number. The council replies that this is impossible: its ledger has no empty beds, no unpaid hours and no undelivered post. Then a second voice whispers a question beneath the official broadcast. How many names have we found?

choices.title: Keep the convoys moving
choices.text: Let the answer be the people arriving outside the cordon.

choices.title: Bring the ledger to council
choices.text: Place the witnesses beside the account that erased them.

choices.title: Sever the broadcast line
choices.text: Find the machinery that keeps speaking over the second voice.

beats.title: One blank column
beats.speaker: Iona Vale
beats.text: The blank column is not a space for people whose names were lost. It is a place for people the council decided not to name. Iona reads the small print twice. There was always room in the infirmary; the empty beds were being held for better entries.

choices.title: Give the beds to the living
choices.text: Finish the evacuation before arguing with another form.

choices.title: Trace every blank entry
choices.text: Ask each witness who should have occupied the missing line.

choices.title: Break the reservation seals
choices.text: Prevent the blank column being used again.

beats.title: The procession
beats.speaker: Bram Voss
beats.text: The procession carries empty boxes beneath the city banners. Bram recognizes the step: he once marched it at the head of an evacuation. Nobody is leading this one. The order has outlived everyone who could remember where it was meant to go.

choices.title: Build a living corridor
choices.text: Hold a route for people who can choose their destination.

choices.title: Identify the bearers
choices.text: Give the procession back the names its banners concealed.

choices.title: Lower the city standard
choices.text: End the march instead of finding another leader for it.

beats.title: A bell without a rope
beats.speaker: Tamsin Reed
beats.text: The twelfth bell has no rope and no clapper. It rings when the other eleven agree that somebody does not count. Tamsin lays a hand against its housing and feels the metal hesitate. A machine can repeat an order. It cannot decide whom we owe an answer.

choices.title: Protect the last carriers
choices.text: Make sure the witnesses reach the end of the route alive.

choices.title: Read the missing names
choices.text: Carry the second account into the council chamber.

choices.title: Remove the governor
choices.text: Keep the bells from being forced into agreement again.

beats.title: The last order
beats.speaker: Mara Rook
beats.text: The council offers to open the cordon if we certify its original evacuation as complete. Nobody has to change a name; we only have to stop counting. Mara leaves the form unsigned. The last order is already coming down the wire. Choose what we will hold when it arrives.

choices.title: Hold the evacuation corridor
choices.text: Put the people coming home before any signature.

choices.title: Answer with the complete list
choices.text: Bring every recovered name into the final hearing.

choices.title: Refuse the command
choices.text: Disconnect the authority that can issue another order.

beats.title: The account remains open
beats.speaker: Mara Rook
beats.text: The last order ends before its final word. Across Lorn, doors remain open without waiting for another instruction. We cannot bring back everyone the city lost. We can decide what it means to keep their place.

endings.title: A road stays open
endings.speaker: Iona Vale
endings.text: The ward runs out of forms before it runs out of beds. Iona uses the clean backs of the pages to write directions to the gate. Every convoy leaves room for somebody who walks slowly. On the first morning without an order, Mara asks whether they should close the cordon. Nobody can think of a reason. The city will remember the missing by making space for whoever arrives next.

endings.title: Names answered
endings.speaker: Vale Ash
endings.text: They put two ledgers on the council table. One says the evacuation was complete. The other contains handwriting from every district: a cook's mark, a child's drawing, names somebody remembered while carrying a stretcher. Vale leaves the last page blank and places a pencil beside it. Every evening the witnesses read what has been added. The twelfth bell is quiet while somebody is answering.

endings.title: No order after this
endings.speaker: Tamsin Reed
endings.text: Tamsin removes the governor without replacing it. The eleven bells can sound the hours, but none can command a door to close. Hux asks how the next shift will know when to begin. People can ask each other, she says. Beyond the foundry, one surviving wire trembles against the stones. They leave it there as a reminder: a city should never be so well ordered that nobody can refuse it.

skirmishes.name: Ward Approach
skirmishes.description: Clear three groups of street dead. Spawn sites have full warnings. This standalone practice scenario awards no boss clear, mastery or campaign record.

specializationSkills.name: Carriage Sentry
specializationSkills.description: A mobile Q machine follows its owner, then braces for half a second before firing. Shorter range and lost moving fire trade sustained output for relocation.

specializationSkills.name: Pressure Charges
specializationSkills.description: Q places an armed proximity charge instead of a turret. Up to two charges; one second arming, half-second visible fuse, ordinary control and finite explosions.

specializationSkills.name: Anchor Circuit
specializationSkills.description: Anchor every carriage, then recall it to follow. Commands share a short recovery and require fresh bracing.

specializationSkills.name: Survey Drive
specializationSkills.description: Order carriages to a fixed, legal point ahead of your aim. They travel there and hold formation.

specializationSkills.name: Coil Lance
specializationSkills.description: Earn a fourth active action: a carriage commits its aim, charges, then fires a piercing beam.

specializationSkills.name: Prism Coils
specializationSkills.description: Coil Lance becomes a three-lane sequence, sweeping a wider approach with separately timed rays.

specializationSkills.name: Salvage Pulse
specializationSkills.description: Earn a fifth active action: dismantle nearby carriages to recover part of Q deployment cooldown.

specializationSkills.name: Rail Convergence
specializationSkills.description: All surviving carriages commit converging rails, followed by a warned collapse at their shared mark.

specializationSkills.name: Tripwire Couplers
specializationSkills.description: Two ready plates share a visible clear tripwire. Crossing it commits both full fuses. Choose this or Safety Switch.

specializationSkills.name: Safety Switch
specializationSkills.description: Q during deployment cooldown or with both slots full holds or releases idle plates. A committed fuse cannot be interrupted. Choose this or Tripwire Couplers.

specializationSkills.name: Firing Key
specializationSkills.description: Add action 1: commit every ready owned plate to its full visible fuse, including held plates.

specializationSkills.name: Breach Casings
specializationSkills.description: Committed explosions also release a warned shaped jet along each plate's placed direction. Cover can shorten the warned lane.

specializationSkills.name: Haul Line
specializationSkills.description: Add action 2: winch a nearby idle plate to a legal aimed position, then fully rearm it. Its original lifetime remains.

specializationSkills.name: Demolition Corridor
specializationSkills.description: Remote-fire two clear linked plates, then release a warned demolition strip. Both plates must actually detonate; interrupted ground cancels the strip.

specializationSkills.name: Field Screen
specializationSkills.description: Q assembles a finite owned screen instead of a turret. It takes half a second to brace; friendly movement remains clear.

specializationSkills.name: Longspan Panels
specializationSkills.description: Build one broad screen with the same health spread over a longer frontage. Excludes Return Wings.

specializationSkills.name: Return Wings
specializationSkills.description: Build two angled side screens instead of a flat front. They share the original health budget and leave the central approach exposed. Excludes Longspan Panels.

specializationSkills.name: Hinged Assembly
specializationSkills.description: Add action1: fold and pivot a nearby owned screen group to a fixed aimed heading. Folded panels cannot block shots.

specializationSkills.name: Field Maintenance
specializationSkills.description: Add action2: stay still for a committed repair to one damaged owned wall. No player healing, shield or lifetime extension.

specializationSkills.name: Linked Foundations
specializationSkills.description: Maintain two separate Q screen groups at once. Each keeps its own original lifetime and assembly window.

specializationSkills.name: Survey Frame
specializationSkills.description: Evolve the hinge action to fold and shift a screen group toward a fixed work point before rebracing. Existing health and expiry remain.

specializationSkills.name: Keystone Redoubt
specializationSkills.description: Impossible Machine also assembles three finite cover panels on clear ground around its original position. The machine keeps its issued behavior; losing it removes its fortification.

specializationSkills.name: Passing Shot
specializationSkills.description: After Precision Burst, use action 1 within 1.2 seconds while holding movement: commit a 90-pixel, 0.3-second step and fire a separate 15-base-damage piercing round on arrival. No dodge immunity; blocked ground rejects without spending the opening.

specializationSkills.name: Crossing Advance
specializationSkills.description: Action 1 commits forward along your aim. Split its original follow-up damage between a departure round and an arrival round; aim again for the arrival shot. You commit the route before moving.

specializationSkills.name: Rear Guard
specializationSkills.description: Action 1 commits backward from your aim. Fire its original follow-up round halfway through and intercept at most one visible hostile projectile in the short forward lane. Other shots and fixed hazards remain dangerous.

specializationSkills.name: Cartridge Drill
specializationSkills.description: Earn action 2: load up to four missing rounds individually while walking. Primary fire waits; use action 2 again to stop with completed rounds retained. Fresh burst/step, dodge, ordinary reload or health damage interrupts.

specializationSkills.name: Roving Chamber
specializationSkills.description: Keep the same finite Cartridge Drill running through fresh Precision Burst and Passing Shot, including either early fork. Coordinate three actions without gaining extra rounds, faster loading or immunity.

specializationSkills.name: Ready Round
specializationSkills.description: The first actual Cartridge Drill insertion opens a short paid Passing Shot. Spend one magazine round for the existing step shot without a burst opening, while respecting its recovery. A normal ready burst follow-up stays free.

specializationSkills.name: Running Volley
specializationSkills.description: Spend a loaded step opening during Passing Shot recovery. Once per drill, completing the first paid step and actually inserting three rounds earns a brief second paid step. Each spends one round and keeps the owned movement/fire/guard variant.

specializationSkills.name: Bank Shot
specializationSkills.description: Spend one magazine round on a deliberate shot that reflects from one masonry face. Plan the angle through real cover; a second wall stops it. Uses action 1 instead of the Skirmisher discipline.

specializationSkills.name: Double Bank
specializationSkills.description: Carry Bank Shot through a second real masonry contact. Its original lifetime and travel budget stay finite; a third wall absorbs it. Choose this instead of Line Drive.

specializationSkills.name: Line Drive
specializationSkills.description: After its first real bank, the shot can pass through one ordinary hostile body. Bosses, weak points and further cover still stop it. Bodies before the bank still intercept. Choose this instead of Double Bank.

specializationSkills.name: Measured Pair
specializationSkills.description: Action 2 spends one actual round on a bank shot and starts twelve seconds of recovery. Its first real cover contact earns 1.2 seconds to manually aim and spend one further round with action 2. At most two shots; the second cannot earn another. Both inherit your chosen bank variant.

specializationSkills.name: Held Measure
specializationSkills.description: After Measured Pair earns its second shot, begin one real manual Reload to keep that opportunity through the reload and 0.6 seconds afterward, at most four seconds total. It cannot be reserved twice. Dodge, channel, overdrive, weapon or technique loss cancels the reserved opportunity. The normal reload still takes its full time; no extra rounds are created.

specializationSkills.name: Angle Relay
specializationSkills.description: Only the second paid Measured Pair shot's first real cover bank earns 0.8 seconds for one paid Bank Shot during its recovery. Spend one real round and extend, rather than reset, the existing Bank Shot recovery. An ordinary ready shot consumes the same opportunity. No automatic shot or recursive proof.

specializationSkills.name: Twin Lanes
specializationSkills.description: When using an earned Angle Relay during Bank Shot recovery, spend two actual rounds to fire two physical bank shots ten degrees to either side of your manual aim. Both inherit your chosen bank variant and use real cover, bodies, travel and armor. Both projectile slots must fit or nothing is spent. One release consumes the relay and extends recovery; neither shot earns another opportunity. Ordinary ready Bank Shot remains one round.

specializationSkills.name: Cooked Canister
specializationSkills.description: Press action 1 to prepare one canister and start ten-second base recovery. Press again to throw along your manual aim. Its 2.4-second fuse keeps running while held or moving; holding to expiry safely vents the canister and spends the recovery. A normal cast starts at 650 pixels/second, slows on the floor, and stops at bodies or cover before its 90-pixel, 80-base-damage blast. Cover and source-sensitive armor apply. A live hand blocks primary fire until you throw or cancel; firing, Reload, dodge, actual health loss, burst or overdrive interrupts it. No friendly damage, ammunition refill or extra resource. Choose this discipline instead of Skirmisher or Marksman.

specializationSkills.name: Skimming Case
specializationSkills.description: The thrown canister banks once from real fixed cover, retaining the unused portion of that tick and eighty percent of its speed. A further wall or a body grounds it; the same finite fuse continues. Excludes Contact Case.

specializationSkills.name: Contact Case
specializationSkills.description: A thrown canister bursts on its first physical body or cover contact instead of waiting on the floor. It cannot bank, seek a target or pass cover. Manual cooking still sets how long it can travel before the fuse expires. Excludes Skimming Case.

specializationSkills.name: Underhand Cast
specializationSkills.description: Action 2 makes a short cast at 280 pixels/second. It can release the canister already in your hand, or prepare and cast a fresh one in a single press if the same recovery is ready. Floor drag, bodies, cover and the actual remaining fuse still apply; no second stock or recovery is created.

specializationSkills.name: Re-pin Drill
specializationSkills.description: One Reload press may re-pin a live hand canister for at most four seconds, freeing the hand. The remaining fuse is stored exactly, never rewound. Action 1 resumes that same canister; it may not be re-pinned twice, including after a later catch. Ordinary magazine reload is separate. Excludes Clipped Sling; this preparation choice is optional before Toe Roll.

specializationSkills.name: Clipped Sling
specializationSkills.description: Keep the live hand canister while using your issued Precision Burst and its owned General transformations. Its fuse keeps running; this grants no burst damage, free ammo or recovery. Primary fire, ordinary Reload, dodge, health loss and overdrive still interrupt it. Excludes Re-pin Drill; this offensive timing choice is optional before Toe Roll.

specializationSkills.name: Toe Roll
specializationSkills.description: Action 2 near your own grounded canister kicks that actual object along manual aim at 420 pixels/second. You must be within 48 pixels with a clear path. One kick per canister; its remaining fuse, casing choice and spent recovery stay exact. A nearby eligible grounded canister takes priority over a fresh short cast. No teleport, new charge, targeting or fuse refresh.

specializationSkills.name: Live Return
specializationSkills.description: Action 1 can catch your own grounded canister within 48 clear pixels when at least 0.2 seconds of fuse remains. It returns the same object to your hand for another manually aimed throw. One catch per canister; its remaining fuse, spent kick/re-pin rights, casing and recovery are retained. Pool rejection cannot eat the held charge. No new explosive, stock or rewound clock.

specializationSkills.name: Settled Shot
specializationSkills.description: Action 1 reserves one actual magazine round and starts ten-second base recovery. Stand still for 0.7 seconds, then press action 1 again to fire a manually aimed, direct 110-base-damage physical shot. Preparation lasts at most three seconds and never fires automatically. Turning more than twelve degrees from the settled bearing recenters the sight and restarts settling within the original deadline. Movement, a new primary press, Reload, dodge, health loss, burst or overdrive cancels the paid preparation without refund. A held primary stays blocked through preparation; release and press it again to cancel. Let an already committed burst finish before preparing. Cover, bodies, travel and source armor apply; no bank, piercing, targeting or immunity. Choose this discipline instead of Skirmisher, Marksman or Grenadier.

specializationSkills.name: Careful Carry
specializationSkills.description: Movement can carry the same paid Settled Shot round within its original three-second preparation. Every actual displacement moves the sight to your current position, recenters its bearing and restarts the full0.7-second settle. Stop and settle before separately releasing; there is no moving release, extra speed, protection or deadline extension. Fresh preparation still requires a planted body. Reload, dodge, actual health loss, channel, burst, overdrive or a new primary press after release still abandons the round. Choose this handling instead of Clear Chamber.

specializationSkills.name: Clear Chamber
specializationSkills.description: During valid Settled Shot preparation, press Reload to return exactly its one reserved round into available magazine space. This cancels preparation and keeps the spent recovery; that press clears the chamber rather than starting an ordinary reload. A full magazine rejects the clear and preserves the paid preparation and original deadline. A later Reload without preparation works normally. Firing, expiry, movement or another interruption returns nothing. Choose this handling instead of Careful Carry.

specializationSkills.name: Bore Through
specializationSkills.description: After preparing and settling Settled Shot, action 2 releases the same paid round with70base ability impact instead of110. It may cross one narrow cover section, at most68pixels along its actual path including the round's width, then retains sixty percent impact. Travel inside cover consumes real time and lifespan; deeper masonry, another solid or the first body stops it. Armor uses your actual firing origin. This is no body piercing, bank, targeting or armor bypass. It cannot prepare a fresh round, extend the original opportunity, return ammunition or reset recovery. Action 1 keeps its direct shot. Careful Carry and Clear Chamber remain optional handling choices.

specializationSkills.name: Field Rest
specializationSkills.description: With no paid round prepared, action2 sets an empty rest at your actual position and bearing. Remain planted for0.7seconds; moving, taking health loss or another action interrupts unfinished setup. Once settled you may leave, but the rest stays fixed and expires9seconds after planting. Return within6pixels and12degrees: an accepted fresh action1 consumes the rest and reserves one actual round ready for a separate manual release. Normal recovery and actual ammunition still apply; unavailable preparation preserves the rest. Elsewhere action1 retains its ordinary full settling. Action2 recalls an existing empty rest, or uses Bore Through when a paid round is prepared. Carry movement restarts settling; Clear returns only the paid round, never the rest. No automatic shot, targeting, remote origin, cover, protection, extra ammunition or new currency.

specializationSkills.name: Prepared Withdrawal
specializationSkills.description: Prepare two separate Field Rest positions at least96pixels apart, each with its real settling, manual bearing and original expiry. Both must be settled before a normally available action1 claims the first. Only a successful separate manual release earns one return opportunity at the other original site. Physically return within its local position/bearing limits: action1 may reserve another actual round during recovery, ready for its own separate manual release. That alternate payment extends spent recovery by one ordinary action1 duration. A normally ready claim consumes the same finite opportunity. With no paid preparation, action2 sets a second site only after the first settles and from sufficient distance; nearer action2, two sites or an armed return means recall the plan. Carry still requires new settling after movement; Clear returns only its reserved round and keeps recovery. No site, right or ammunition is restored and a return cannot earn another return. Physical bodies, cover, time and firing-origin armor remain.

specializationSkills.name: Flak Round
specializationSkills.description: Spend one magazine round to launch a defensive flak shell along your manual aim. Its 0.6-second fuse or first body/cover contact makes one burst at its actual position. After nearby shots move, the 45-pixel burst clears at most three small hostile projectiles with clear line of sight. It deals no body damage and cannot clear large objects, beams, fields or ground attacks. Protection begins only at the burst; earlier hits remain. Moving and Braced Firing are allowed. Reloading, dodging, channeling, overdrive, empty ammunition or a full projectile pool rejects launch without payment. Ordinary primary pauses for the launch. Base recovery is eight seconds.

specializationSkills.name: Close Pattern
specializationSkills.description: Fit a shorter 0.4-second fuse and a 60-pixel all-around burst. It reaches less distant ground before bursting, but covers every bearing. One magazine round, at most three small hostile shots and the same recovery; real bodies and cover still stop the shell. Choose this fitting instead of Forward Baffle.

specializationSkills.name: Forward Baffle
specializationSkills.description: Fit a longer 0.8-second fuse and a 90-pixel forward burst within a 70-degree fan. The fan keeps the original firing bearing and leaves a real rear gap. One magazine round, at most three small hostile shots and the same recovery; real bodies and cover still stop the shell. Choose this fitting instead of Close Pattern.

specializationSkills.name: Manual Fuze
specializationSkills.description: Use action 2 to burst your one actual flying flak shell at its present position. Command it before the original fuse ends; the burst still waits until nearby shots have moved. It cannot act on the launch moment, create another shell or burst, return ammunition or reset recovery. Busy hands reject the command while the original flight and fuse continue. Without a live own shell there is no action to command. Both optional burst fittings retain their actual geometry.

specializationSkills.name: Running Fuze
specializationSkills.description: Change your first Action 2 command into one early interception pulse while the same paid shell keeps flying. That pulse may clear at most one actual small hostile shot. The original fuse or first body/cover contact later makes the final pulse, using only the unspent part of the original combined three-shot allowance. An empty early pulse uses no interception allowance, but the command is still spent. You cannot command that shell again. No new round, extra carrier, extended fuse or recovery reset. Choose this handling instead of Hanging Fuze; omitting both keeps the original immediate three-shot Manual Fuze.

specializationSkills.name: Hanging Fuze
specializationSkills.description: Your first Action 2 command arrests the actual shell at its current air position and firing bearing. It does not burst on that command or extend its original fuse. A separate later Action 2 can burst the same shell there; its original fuse or an actual enemy body contact can still end it. The one burst retains the original three-small-shot allowance and real cover. Busy rejection keeps the arrested shell and original deadline. No teleport, attachment, extra round, persistent mine, refund or recovery reset. Choose this handling instead of Running Fuze; omitting both keeps the original immediate Manual Fuze.

specializationSkills.name: Seam Fuze
specializationSkills.description: While your paid flak shell is still live, press Action 1 again to cut its flight and clear a thin seam along the ground it actually crossed. The seam reaches 9 pixels to either side and uses only the unspent part of that shell’s original three-small-shot allowance. Action 2 keeps your acquired point-burst operation, so choose a narrow line behind the shell or a wider burst at it. Running Fuze spends from the same allowance; Hanging Fuze retains only the line laid before arrest. Real cover crossing that line permanently severs it for this shell, leaving Action 2 and the original fuse available. Cut before the original fuse ends. Busy hands reject without cutting. No extra round, body damage, shield, recovery reset or lingering trap.
